| Name         | Type                 | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------ | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `content`    | `object`             |          | `\{\}`  | The list config: `{ register, schema, filter?, sort?, limit?, extend?, presentation?, variant?, lead?, title?, meta?, text?, label?, pill?, trailing?, icon?, rowRoute?, rowIdField?, headerLink?, headerNote?, emptyText?, errorText?, valueLabels?, endpointSource?, bar? }`. `bar` (`{ valueField, maxField?, overVariant? }`) draws a thin track under each row: filled to `valueField` against `maxField` (drawn in the error colour past it with `overVariant: "error"`), or without `maxField` against the largest row. `endpointSource` (`{ url, method?, params?, responsePath? }`) reads the rows from an app endpoint instead of `register` / `schema`. `valueLabels` maps a field's stored values to the labels the templates show. `headerNote` and `headerLink.label` fill `{total}` and `{count:&lt;field&gt;=&lt;value&gt;}`, the loaded rows with that value. A row that is a plain string or number (an endpoint answering `["…", "…"]`) is read as `{ value }`: templates reach it as `{value}`, and without `title` a row shows the value itself. `presentation: "notice"` draws the rows as sentences in one box toned by `variant` (`info`, `warning` or `error`), after an optional `lead` (`{total}` filled in). |
| `objectId`   | `string&#124;number` |          | `null`  | The current record's id, for the `@objectId` token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `objectData` | `object`             |          | `null`  | The current record, for `@object.&lt;field&gt;` tokens.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
